title: An operator algebraic approach for generalized Cardano polynomials
summary: We develop an operator algebraic framework for generalized Cardano polynomials and show how their structure naturally leads to an operator formulation of Cardano method that is compatible with tools and concepts from quantum information theory. The generalized Cardano polynomials are constructed as a generalization of classical theory of Cardano formula for cubic equation, as well as through the spectral properties of a circular operator W, expressed in terms of n dimensional clock operator. This representation embeds Cardano type identities into the spectral theory of circulant operators.…
